title: Stage IV Melanoma Thriver
content: Stage IV Melanoma ThriverRadical Remission ProjectJul 7, 20241 min readAs a fifth-generation Texan, James Templeton tapped into his fighting spirit. He became a 36-year cancer survivor healing himself from a terminal diagnosis of Stage IV Melanoma with the use of alternative medicine and healing modalities. As the visionary founder of Uni Key Health Systems and the Templeton Wellness Foundation, James has since utilized his wisdom and experience to help others achieve optimum health and wellnessVisit www.IUsedToHaveCancer.com to get a glimpse of James’ inspiring story.
